summary: The legal source domain caps the input string at 300 characters and every dictionary word at 20 characters. Trie construction reads S dictionary characters, and the candidate explores at most 20 trie edges from each reachable string boundary.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The verified source constraints are 1 <= s.length <= 300, 1 <= wordDict.length <= 1000, and 1 <= wordDict[i].length <= 20.

replacement_checks.evidence: Building the trie performs one insertion per dictionary character, for O(S) work. From each of n string boundaries, traversal examines no more than the source-bounded maximum of 20 characters, so the complete segmentation scan is O(n) on the legal domain and total time is O(S + n).

The source-fidelity-verified examples cover dictionary-word reuse, multiple boundaries, and an ambiguous prefix with no complete segmentation; black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition.
